{{Quote|I'm Victor's secretary. I schedule his trips, meetings... just about everything! Are you going to vote for him? It's just so exciting! He has so many great changes in store for Bestine.|Keanna Li'kyna|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Keanna Li'kyna''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] secretary to [[Victor Visalis]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Keanna Li'kyna appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
